0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
25 attr ::= ATTRLIST
26 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
27 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
28 attrs ::= empty
29 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
30 attrs ::= attrs attr
31 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
32 optsiglist ::= empty
33 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
34 expr ::= listexpr
35 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
36 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
37 listexpr ::= term
38 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
39 termbinop ::= term ADDOP term
40 termbinop ::= termrelop
41 termbinop ::= termeqop
42 termrelop ::= relopchain
43 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
44 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
45 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
46 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
47 termeqop ::= eqopchain
48 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
49 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
50 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
51 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
52 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
53 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
54 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term
55 termunop ::= term POSTINC
56 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
57 termunop ::= PREINC term
58 termunop ::= PREDEC term
59 term ::= termbinop
60 term ::= termunop
61 term ::= myattrterm
62 term ::= scalar
63 term ::= star
64 term ::= hsh
65 term ::= ary
66 term ::= arylen
67 term ::= THING
68 term ::= amper
69 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm attrlist
70 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm
71 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN myterm attrlist
72 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN term
73 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
74 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
75 myterm ::= scalar
76 myterm ::= hsh
77 myterm ::= ary
78 optlistexpr ::= empty
79 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
80 optexpr ::= empty
81 optexpr ::= expr
82 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
83 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
84 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
85 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
86 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
87 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
